beats.care: Cheap weekend plan: hop from Cuffe Parade to Marol Naka collecting stamps. Stock is limited, first come first served, digital payment only.
beats.what: From Oct 16, Mumbai Metro sells a limited-edition passport where riders collect stamps at 10 Aqua Line stations, for Rs 250.
beats.why: It's a special anniversary offer for Mumbai's first underground metro line.

cards.q: What do you collect in the Aqua Line passport?
cards.why: It's a souvenir booklet that you fill with stamps from ten Line 3 stations.

cards.body: The 33.5 km line from Aarey JVLR to Cuffe Parade runs daily from 5:55 am to 10:30 pm.
cards.caption: Aqua Line fare range

cards.body: Cuffe Parade, Churchgate, Hutatma Chowk, CSMT Metro, Worli, Siddhivinayak, Dharavi, BKC, CSMIA-T2 and Marol Naka.
cards.title: Where are the stamps?

opts: Just buying it as a souvenir
cards.q: Would you do the full stamp trail?

hook: Can a *metro ride* get you passport stamps in Mumbai?

learn.t: About 7 crore passengers have ridden the Aqua Line since it began running on October 8, 2025.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.title: Mumbai Metro Launches Aqua Line Passport At 10 Stations For Rs 250

tldr: Mumbai Metro is selling a Rs 250 collectible Aqua Line 'passport' that you fill with stamps from 10 underground stations.
